title: A drill-down link saved before the release still opens on its customer
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Before the release was installed, you clicked {Customer-A}'s name on A/R Summary and saved the address of the A/R Collection page it opened, and did the same for {Vendor-A} on A/P Summary.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST REL-11 Old Bookmark and {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST REL-11 Old Bookmark Parts.
  • {Customer-A} had overdue invoices and {Vendor-A} unpaid bills on the day the addresses were saved.
  • Starting screen: the release is installed; the ShopView home page is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the A/R Collection address saved before the release.
  2. Open the A/P Unpaid Invoices address saved before the release.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: A/R Collection opens, with no error; the chip reads "Customer: " and {Customer-A}'s name, and only {Customer-A}'s group is listed.
  • Step 2: A/P Unpaid Invoices opens, with no error; the chip reads "Vendor: " and {Vendor-A}'s name, and only {Vendor-A}'s group is listed.

Why: today's drill-down writes the customer or vendor into the address in an older form; the tech plan says the new reports still read it, so bookmarks made before the release keep working.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R14: “A customer or vendor ticked through a link, a reload or a Summary drill-down is named and ticked on the chip, even when it is not among the first results of the chip's search.”
  • Key Decisions, drill-down: “Drill-down keeps the report's scope. Clicking a customer or vendor on a Summary opens Collection or Unpaid Invoices with the same as-of date and the same chosen locations. Basis: d-drill-in-inherits-scope.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §3 D30: “URL keys asOfDate, customerIds / vendorIds, pastDue, locationIds (repeated keys written, comma lists also read); legacy customerId / vendorId read once as aliases.”
  • Tech plan §6 Phase 2, frontend: “Until Phase 3 the link keeps today's target query (asOfDate, customerId, customerName), because the legacy Collection page reads only those;”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html).
